description:
200 Transformers

 -Must be 1600 Watt.

-Transformer 220/240 Volt to 110 Volt.

-Must be step down only.

-All EU plugs must be dual polarity.

-Steel sheet housing must be gray color.

-Must have portable handle.

-Single phase FFP-self cooling.

-2-meter flexible cable, shuko plug type F.

-Must have 2 each U.S. socket only compatible with plugs type A & B.

-Must have 2 primary circuit breaker 4,5 AMP to react as overload and to be used as an on-off switch.

-Location of circuit breaker/on-off switch must be in the front centered above socket.
